$comment: D-CSUBSET-VLA C4b: a VLA TYPEDEF (`typedef int R[n]; R a;`) RUNS on all 3 legs. C99 §6.7.7p2 evaluates the size expr ONCE at the typedef and FREEZES it; every later `R a;` allocates with that frozen size. Two witnesses carry the weight: (A) FREEZE-ONCE — after mutating `n` to 100 between two `R` objects, BOTH `a` and `b` stay int[3] (proven by the runtime `sizeof a == sizeof b == 12`; a leak would re-eval n=100 => 400), returns 1/2 the strict catch; (B) MULTI-DIM OFF-DIAGONAL — `c[1][0]` vs `c[0][1]` (and `d`'s) are DISTINCT cells, so a wrong copied-down runtime row stride would alias/transpose them (returns 5/6/9/10). `sizeof c[0]` / `sizeof d[0]` pin the copied-down per-level row slots. ★ LIFTED in P59: main used to be kept a LEAF (no calls) because a VLA-object holder that CALLS was refused (D-CSUBSET-VLA-NONLEAF-CALL-FRAME); it now makes a TEN-argument call with a, b, c and d all live and re-reads every one of them afterwards (returns 18..22), so the objects are witnessed to survive stack-argument writes into the outgoing-args area that travels with SP. ★★ SECTION (D) WAS LIFTED IN THE SAME CYCLE BY A SECOND LANE, AND WHY IT COULD NOT SEE ITS OWN DEFECT IS THE LESSON. It used to be left un-lifted because a MULTI-DECLARATOR VLA statement (`R4 e, f;`) mis-lowered its C5 teardown — the declaration's own wrapper freed BOTH objects at the end of the STATEMENT, so the next object in the scope landed on `e` (✔MEASURED at HEAD in a LEAF function: gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 both right, DSS reading one object's data out of another). ⚠ This section could not have caught it even so, because its only later object was `const R4 g;`, which is never STORED TO. A written `R4 h;` was added and e's and f's element reads now sit BELOW those stores (returns 23/24). [[D-CSUBSET-VLA-MULTIDECLARATOR-STATEMENT-TEARDOWN]], closed P59. ⚠ Returns 23/24 and not 18/19 because the ten-argument-call arms above already hold 18..22: two lanes appended to this program from the same base and both reached for 18/19, which a clean textual merge did not notice. The arm64 leg proves the copy-down stride math on the non-host target; the `release` arm proves R's frozen size slots + the copied-down slots survive the full optimizer (never folded to a constant, never dropped). exitCode 42; return 1..12 are the strict in-program pins.
